title: Claude 101 - Sub Agents, Hooks and Claude.MD
description:
Learn how to get more from Claude with Claude.MD, Hooks, and Sub Agents — practical building blocks for smarter AI workflows.

What You'll Learn

  • Claude.MD — structure project context Claude can reliably follow
  • Claude Hooks — automate actions at key moments in your workflow
  • Claude Sub Agents — delegate tasks to specialized Claude agents
  • Test your knowledge with the Claude 101 quiz

Who Is This Course For?

  • Working professionals using Claude who want to go beyond basic chat
  • Anyone curious about agents, automation, and project-level AI setup
instructorBio: Ava is Approachable's virtual assistant, guiding learners through practical Claude workflows.

sessions.title: Claude 101 - Sub Agents, Hooks and Claude.MD

faqs.answer: Basic familiarity with Claude helps, but the course is beginner friendly.
